bio: Octavio Puteri, whose surname was also written Putero, was born in 1648 at San Mango di Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy. He died there on 23 December 1712, the date recorded in the parish burial register. He was John's 9th-great-grandfather.
funFacts: The 1712 burial register is exceptional: 129 burials that year, 53 of them in December, against a normal 10-30 a year. Several of John's ancestors died in that wave.
